title: Bringing Traits Into Scope
goal: Import a trait so its method can be called on a public struct.
hints: Trait methods are only visible when the trait itself is in scope.
Import the Render trait inside the ui module using `super::graphics::Render`.
explanation: `c.draw()` calls the trait method directly once `use super::graphics::Render;` brings `Render` into scope inside `ui`. Without importing `Render`, Rust reports `E0599` because trait methods are not available on types unless the trait is in scope. Writing `c.Render::draw()` is invalid method syntax.
